name: Target Food Distribution Center West Jefferson (T3804)

fieldNotes.siteId: Building correctly identified as the Target FOOD DC at 42 Commerce Pkwy (Target's internal id for the food DC is T3880; the task title carries T3804, which is the adjacent regional/GM DC). Confirmed via Street View: the long building immediately south carries a JLL/Stonemont 'Available - 44 Commerce Parkway, 1,090,000 s.f.' banner, fixing 42 Commerce as the audited center building.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE. Fence contractor (Lannis Fence Co.) documents '2,000+ ft of chain-link security perimeter fence with a fully equipped operated entrance gate and access controls system' plus a decorative ornamental gate at the employee/office entrance. Truck yard is fenced and access-controlled; truck entry is at the NE corner where the yard meets the campus interior drive.
fieldNotes.guardShack: FALSE (medium confidence). No staffed guard booth was visible at any truck lane in satellite imagery; the only small detached structure (tan-roof) sits by the SE retention pond away from the truck path and reads as a utility/pump building. Contractor language emphasizes an 'access controls system', not a manned booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: TRUE. Gate present but no guard shack observed -> automated/kiosk/card access control implied by the documented 'access controls system'.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 25-50 (uncertain). Dock bank is on the NORTH face only, facing the shared trailer yard; counted roughly 40-50 doors across the ~700 ft north wall of this 438,000 sf refrigerated DC. South/west walls are blank (rooftop refrigeration units only).
fieldNotes.dropYard: TRUE. The food DC docks open onto an enormous shared drop/trailer yard (with the adjacent regional DC) holding hundreds of trailers in dense rows; dropArea banded 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: FALSE. Single north-face dock bank; no second dock cluster on a different building face.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: TRUE (inferred). Wide paved apron between the gate/yard entry and the dock face provides interior holding room.
fieldNotes.siteArea: Traced fenced operational perimeter ~30.7 acres. Published parcel is 47 acres (includes undeveloped buffer land and the property's share of the shared trailer yard not enclosed in the operational ring).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - edge-of-town logistics park off I-70 / SR-29 near West Jefferson, surrounded by farmland.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: FALSE - rural but within an active, dense industrial park; cellular coverage expected adequate.

citations.claim: Active Target full-time hourly warehouse-operations req tagged food-DC facility code T3880 at West Jefferson, OH.
Target announced the West Jefferson, OH food DC at 42 Commerce Parkway; facility opened 2014 and serves OH plus nine states.

verification.rationale: Active Target food-DC careers reqs (facility code T3880) at 42 Commerce Pkwy, West Jefferson OH confirm current operation; opened 2014, not under construction. Title T3804 is the adjacent RDC; audited building is the T3880 food DC.
